properties.title: NRC Report: Several Different Types Of Chemicals Mixed To Drench With The Apples near Brewster, WA
properties.summary: Incident Type: STORAGE TANK - NRC Report ID: 888570 - Medium Affected: OTHER - Suspected Responsible Party: CUSTOM APPLE PACKERS
properties.content:
NRC Report ID: 888570
Incident Time: 2008-10-29 17:00:00
Nearest City: Brewster, WA
Incident Type: STORAGE TANK
Material: SEVERAL DIFFERENT TYPES OF CHEMICALS MIXED TO DRENCH WITH THE APPLES
Medium Affected: OTHER
Suspected Responsible Party: CUSTOM APPLE PACKERS
Skytruth Analysis
CALLER IS REPORTING A RELEASE OF HYDRAULIC OIL FROM A LARGE RUPTURED HYDRAULIC TANK THAT OCCURRED APPROX TWO AND A HALF YEARS AGO. CALLER STATES THE OIL DRAINED INTO A SEPTIC TANK WHICH IS CONNECTED TO A DRAIN FIELD THAT EVENTUALLY GOES ONTO THE GROUND AND POSSIBLY IMPACTS THE COLUMBIA RIVER (100 YARDS FROM THE LOCATION). CALLER ALSO STATES THIS INCIDENT HAS OCCURRED SEVERAL TIMES SINCE TWO YEARS AGO. AS AN ADDITION, THE FACILITY TREATS APPLES BY DRENCHING TRUCK LOADS AND THE MATERIAL THEY DRENCH IT WITH IS SUPPOSED TO BE KEPT OUT OF THE GROUND WATER. THERE ARE TIMES THE MATERIAL GOES INTO AN "EVAC" POND BUT WHEN IT GETS TOO FULL THEY GET RID OF THE CONTENTS BY PUTTING IT INTO AN IMPROPER AREA. CALLER STATES THE MATERIAL CONSISTS OF SEVERAL DIFFERENT CHEMICALS AND THIS INCIDENT IS STILL AN ONGOING ISSUE.

THIS ANOMALY IS UNCONFIRMED AS OIL. IT WAS OBSERVED 173.97 NM SOUTHEAST OF CAPE MAY, NJ. THE ANOMALY APPEARED SIGNIFICANTLY DARKER AND MORE DISTINCT THAN NATURAL PHENOMENA. IT SHOWED A SEGMENTED APPEARANCE, WITH SOME FEATHERING IN THE SOUTHEASTERN PORTION. IN TOTAL, IT MEASURED APPROXIMATELY 11.08 NM IN LENGTH AND 0.60 NM AT ITS WIDEST POINT.
